One thing that has been driving me nuts and needs fixing is chairs/stations bugging out when instances are old enough. The instance owner gets stuck in them for late joiners and only gets fixed when the new user turns off chairs in the world or the person "in the chair" sits in it themselves and exits. this has to be repeated for every person entering the instance after the bug appears. 

Another thing related to the bug is how the audio seems to flicker between the "sitting" users stationed position and true position.


Chairs also break locomotion for FBT and 3 point-tracking depending on how its set up in unity (locomotion seems the most likely to be the culprit)

All of the above has been an issue for months now. I do not recall when exactly it was introduced.

I can't remember which build that started this bug but this happens in a world with stations. New joiners sees a random user getting stuck in station. You can tell that the user is not in a sitting animation. You can also tell that the user's audio is splitting between the users actual location and the bugged station.

details:
I have seen this bug very often since the recent updates (1017 being current). 
On joining an instance the current instance master may appear to be sitting in a random chair in the world. The player will remain stuck in the chair for you until they sit in the chair and leave it. 
This seems to happen to instances that have been open for a while, there does not seem to be any pattern to which chair the person is sitting in. This happens even if the player has never sat in a chair in the world. It only happens to the player the has been in the world the longest, so that is what I am calling Instance Master.
title: Instance Master apppears to be sitting in a chair to new players joining
